'''August 2003 Overland Park tournament''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG sealed-deck tournament held on Saturday 2 August 2003 at Vintage Stock, 9200 Metcalf Ave., Overland Park, Kansas, the fourth event of the [[2003 Vintage Stock Tour]], with [[Vicki Luthy]] as tournament director.<ref name="pcf-1855-30308">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=30308#30308 Vintage Stock Tour!], Guy Kargl (Freelancer), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (4 July 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040707042014/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=31994%26amp Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-1855-32057">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=32057#32057 Vintage Stock Tour!], Guy Kargl (Freelancer), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (28 August 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040707042014/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=31994%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> Eight players took part.<ref name="pcf-1855-32057" />

For the $10 entry each player received one [[Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]], two [[Reflections]] boosters, four [[Cloud City Limited|Cloud City]] boosters and one pack each of [[Death Star II (expansion)|Death Star II]], [[Special Edition]] and [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]]; Luthy added five more Death Star II and five more Special Edition packs, 20 packs of [[Jabba's Palace Limited|Jabba's Palace]] and an [[Official Tournament Sealed Deck]] pack to the pool. The players made a draft pull from the product before building their decks.<ref name="pcf-1855-32057" />

Light Side won most of the games. Paul Pansing had to leave for work, and Luthy, who had been playing, dropped out so that no player would have a bye. Brian Tindell won the [[Death Star II (expansion)|Death Star II]] Light Side uncut sheet given away at random.<ref name="pcf-1855-32057" />

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Vintage Stock, 9200 Metcalf Ave., Overland Park, Kansas<ref name="pcf-1855-30308" />
* '''Dates:''' 2 August 2003<ref name="pcf-1855-30308" /><ref name="pcf-1855-32057" />
* '''Format:''' [[Sealed Deck]] with a draft pull<ref name="pcf-1855-32057" />
* '''Fee:''' $10<ref name="pcf-1855-30308" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Vicki Luthy]]<ref name="pcf-1855-32057" />
* '''Players:''' 8<ref name="pcf-1855-32057" />
